title_zh: 深夜找聊天机器人帮忙
title_en: Artificial Intelligence (18/20): Late-Night Help from a Chatbot
note_en: 只要……就…… means "as long as ... then": the first clause names a condition that is enough on its own, and 就 marks the result that follows almost automatically: 只要她把问题说清楚，聊天机器人就能……给出一份详细的回答 "as long as she states her question clearly, the chatbot can produce a detailed answer." Unlike English, Chinese keeps 就 in the second clause even after a subject (聊天机器人就能), and leaving it out sounds incomplete. Compare 如果 "if," which is a neutral condition with no sense of "that's all it takes."
